company_description: Builds a distributed network of mass-manufacturable electronically steerable phased-array satellite ground stations (Portal) to downlink satellite data.

company_description: Electronic-warfare company focused on spectrum dominance for the US and allies in drone-dominated battlefields.

company_description: Building space-to-space optical power-beaming infrastructure to deliver power to satellites without custom receivers.

company_description: Builds FUZZ-E, an AI-native offensive-cyber platform covering the full kill chain, for US cyber forces.

company_description: Ukrainian maker of combat-proven autonomous systems used in tens of thousands of missions, expanding into NATO markets and the US.
